## Welcome

I am a doctoral student in Business Administration with a concentration in Finance at the
[Strome College of Business](https://www.odu.edu/strome), Old Dominion University.

My research sits at the intersection of **asset pricing, financial economics, corporate finance and geopolitical risk **. I am currently working on how the defense sector prices different components of geopolitical risk, and on the
economic consequences of climate change for the Chesapeake Bay fishery.

Before starting the PhD I completed an M.S. in Economics (Econometrics and Quantitative Economics)
at the University of North Texas, and worked in corporate affairs at Bangladesh Honda Private Limited.

**Research interests**

- Asset pricing and the cross-section of returns
- Geopolitical and climate risk in financial markets
- corporate finance
- International finance

**Education**

- Ph.D. Business Administration, Finance — Old Dominion University, 2025–present
- M.S. Economics (Econometrics and Quantitative Economics) — University of North Texas, 2025
- M.S.S. Economics — Noakhali Science & Technology University, 2019
- B.S.S. Economics — Noakhali Science & Technology University, 2018
